description: Claude Code Bash permission prompt (current layout: rule-topped, description under the tool header, command and auto-mode notice in │ gutters) whose prompt is only "Do you want to proceed?". MUST be a user-waiting menu, and classify() must carry the widget's own rows as question.context (tool, description, command, blocking notice) so a card shows what is being approved. Synthetic, genericized from a live pane. The card's plain restatement (question.ask) must say approving stops the two preview servers, and mention nothing destructive that the command does not do.
